title: The Orthotic Is Still in the Mail
thesis: CRI's nine FY2026 launches are an event. The harder public count is how many of the 122 companies built on Northeastern research since 2011 are still listed active. InLoop's 24-hour orthotic is a development claim, not a clinic result.

script.text: Your foot hurts for weeks because the orthotic is still in the mail.
CRI says InLoop is developing an in-clinic orthotic and claims a turnaround of 24 hours.
Claimed turnaround. Not a clinic result.
CRI says nine companies launched this year. The harder count is older.
Since 2011, CRI lists 122 companies, 61 still listed active.
Launching is not the same verb as lasting.

closing_payoff: Launching is not the same verb as lasting.
